example:
import { Persona } from "@godxjp/ui/data-display";

<Persona name={member.name} description={member.email} size="sm" />
name: Persona

props.description: Full primary label, retained in native title and accessible text; dir=auto preserves its beginning in RTL.
props.name: name

props.description: Optional full secondary label (email/handle), independently truncated and titled with dir=auto.
props.name: description

props.description: Optional image URL; Avatar owns loading and fallback.
props.name: avatarSrc

props.description: Fallback content; defaults to the first Unicode code point of name. Avatar is decorative beside the full name.
props.name: avatarFallback

props.description: Optional noninteractive badge beside the name, outside its truncation box.
props.name: trailing

props.description: Avatar control tier and name type scale; secondary text stays xs.
props.name: size

props.description: Root class; native span attributes and ref are forwarded.
props.name: className

related: ListRow — padded short-list row with actions
tagline: Compact person identity: fixed avatar, independently truncated name and muted secondary line, optional inline badge.
usage: Use inside DataTable renderers and stacked rows. Persona owns no row padding, navigation, account action or business state.
Pass localized labels and badge content. Retune --persona-* tokens; avatar sizing uses existing --avatar-* tokens.
Both full labels stay in the accessibility tree and native titles. Keep trailing content noninteractive.
